title: generate-service-health-report runtime parameters
description: Azure SRE runtime input schema. Numeric parameter type is int (not JSON Schema's integer). Identity, source scope, branding, query text and output directory are administrator-owned code configuration, never inputs.

period.description: auto requests previous UTC calendar-month updates for report, last 24-hour updates for query. Active observed and future maintenance retain separate context from the source's 365-day lastUpdateTime lookback; monthly recurrence is not a historical-completeness promise.

start_utc.description: Only with custom: ISO 8601 timestamp with Z or explicit zero UTC offset, up to microsecond precision. At most 93 days, within the retained-source lookback; no sub-microsecond rounding.

end_utc.description: Only with custom: exclusive UTC end with up to microsecond precision, after start and no later than the run reference.

view.description: Query projection; raw records/page envelopes remain in full report JSON.

event_type.description: Exact query-only local event category. Never broadens source access.

state.description: Query-only source-observed current status, not historical status or workload health.

time_scope.description: Query-only local temporal classification. Lanes can overlap. Newness is never automatically established.

search.description: Query-only case-insensitive substring over event ID/name/title/summary, service and region. Not a URL or source-side query.

limit.description: Query-only requested page size. Whole projected rows may be fewer to meet the 3500-byte default-JSON transport bound. Report requires the default.

offset.description: Query-only offset. Use returned next_offset. Every invocation is a fresh read, not a stable previous-report cursor. Report requires zero.
